verdict.rationale: Mem0's official MCP server gives agents memory tools so they can decide for themselves when to save, look up, or update memories. The CLI, described as being for both humans and AI agents, covers add, search, list, update, and delete. Probes confirm the MCP server, the CLI, and a published OpenAPI spec, so the agent can also call the API directly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a delete tool in the MCP toolset, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents managing memory mid-conversation.
